title: Install a graphics card and two RAM sticks (Franka, operational-space control)
text: Install the graphics card and the two RAM sticks in the PC. The card goes in the PCIe x16 slot, the stick from the holder farther from the robot in the outermost memory slot, and the other stick in the second slot from the CPU socket.
success: Success: the card and both sticks are pressed fully into their slots, each straight and square: the card in the x16 slot, a quarter turn clockwise (seen from above) from the way it stands in its holder; the stick from the farther holder in the outermost memory slot and the other in the second slot from the CPU socket, each facing the way it stands in its holder (not reversed).
